subject: Concierge credit request — sprint hold from connector sync failure
messages:
From: Alice Zhou <alice@ductileai.com>
To: dev_patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Bob Li <bob@ductileai.com>
Date: Wed, 20 Aug 2025 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot blocked: connector sync failing — request for temporary cushion

Hi Dev,

We hit a hard stop this morning during our final connector sync to production — the pipeline is failing with a repeatable serialization error and the engineering team needs an extra sprint cycle to patch and validate.

This pauses our pilot and blocks the demo next week. Our SRE says they won't be unblocked for ~10 business days without additional engineering headcount. Given that, we're asking if Redwood can provide: 
- a 30-day extension on the pilot window, and
- a one-time sandbox credit to cover demo and evaluation usage (we're asking for ~$3k worth of credits).

I attached the connector logs and a screenshot of the error. If you need any other traces or a short call with our eng lead (Bob), we're available this afternoon. This is a time-sensitive ask — the demo calendar is slipping and execs are watching.

Thanks,
Alice
Alice Zhou
Head of Platform
Ductile AI

Attachment: connector-sync.log (text/plain)
Attachment: onboarding-error-screenshot.png (image/png)

From: dev_patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Zhou <alice@ductileai.com>
Cc: Bob Li <bob@ductileai.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 20 Aug 2025 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot blocked: connector sync failing — request for temporary cushion

Hi Alice — thanks for the quick note and for the logs. I'm sorry to hear you're blocked.

We can absolutely try to make this as painless as possible. I want to move quickly: two asks from my side to get an approval path started:
1) I will escalate to Sales Ops and our CS lead (looping Marissa) for a concierge credit + extension.
2) Can Bob share the smallest reproducible trace (stack + request id) for the serialization error? That'll help our infra folks estimate how long a mitigation will take.

Tentatively, we can propose a 30-day extension and a conditional sandbox credit; final amount needs sign-off from Ben (sales manager). I'll come back with concrete numbers within 24 hours. If it's urgent, I can pull Markus (infra/product) in for a quick triage.

Call available at 3pm PT today if you want us all to meet.

— Dev
Dev Patel
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0142

Team — forwarding the log and Alice's note. Quick context: Ductile AI (pilot, coming up on demo) hit a serialization failure in connector sync; they estimate ~10 business days to fully patch without extra help. Alice is asking for a 30-day window extension + a sandbox credit to keep the pilot running for demos.

Why I think we should approve (short):
- High ARR motion if pilot converts — mid-six-figure potential.
- Engineering delay is external to our runtime; they need runway for their QA cycle.
- Approving a modest concierge credit is lower cost than losing the pipeline and the deal.

Suggested approval: 30-day extension + $3,000 sandbox credit (apply as promo to their account). Approver: Ben for credit budget; Markus for any infra/product caveats (e.g., we shouldn't promise private infra changes).

Marissa — if you can draft the promo code and apply the extension in the console, we'll need to record the HubSpot note (link below). Ben — can you confirm budget/limits? Markus — any reason this is unacceptable from a product/ops standpoint?

Related HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/67890/company/3421

Thanks,
— Dev

Thanks for flagging. Ben here — I approve a limited concierge credit for Ductile AI as a retention gesture. Details: 
- 30-day extension to pilot window
- $2,500 sandbox credit applied to their account (one-time promotional credit)
- Standard condition: credits are for evaluation/demo usage only and expire 60 days after issuance.

Marissa — please: 1) create promo code PROMO-DUCTILE-2500, 2) apply 30-day extension in the console, and 3) add a HubSpot note under Deal RDW-2025-0873 with the approval text.

Markus — no infra changes required from our side; this is purely billing/console. If you foresee any risk with applying promo to an in-flight pilot, flag it now.

Ben Carter
Revenue Lead | Redwood Inference
